name: cineverse-movie-ticket-booking
description: CINEVERSE — a movie ticket booking system. React + Express + MySQL, with an optional OpenRouter AI layer.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run install:all && npm run db:reset
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && cd ../frontend && npm install --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.verify: npm run posters && npm run build && npm test
